_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P2 operational targets.

requirements.title: Publish performance ingestion
requirements.description: Per-post engagement telemetry, once social accounts and measurement sources exist. Deferred because it cannot be built or validated before there are live accounts producing measurable posts. Its real-provider telemetry activation remains capability/permission-qualified. The accepted delivery nevertheless implements safe native/manual observation intake, exact definition/window/denominator provenance, correction and deduplication contracts through CONTENTD-P0-034; no live account is needed to fake a metric.

validation.notes: Deferred: requires live accounts and a measurement source before evidence is meaningful.

requirements.title: Per-channel variant derivation
requirements.description: This accepted delivery requires independently editable channel snapshots derived from exact source revisions, with deliberate differences and proposed updates. Reused evidence remains usable only for unchanged supported wording/current scope; derivation never transfers editorial or release approval or silently skips affected verification.

validation.notes: Deferred: a derived variant inherits the parent's verified claim set without re-verification.

requirements.title: Identity-consistent media linkage
requirements.description: Asset Studio is the current owner of released image and video media references; Content Desk stores links and no bytes. Qualified identity-consistent generation remains conditional. Required image/carousel composition and source-linked video planning/script/handoff do not mandate persona production or universal automated video rendering.

validation.notes: Deferred: requires an asset-production scenario to exist before the seam is real.

requirements.title: Outcome-driven hook promotion
requirements.description: Proposing hook-library promotions from measured post outcomes rather than editorial taste. Depends on telemetry, so it inherits that deferral. Preserve conditional measured hook promotion; accepted learning can propose a bounded hypothesis/experiment from honest qualitative observations without automatic hook, strategy or post-type adoption.

validation.notes: Deferred: depends on publish-performance data that does not yet exist.

requirements.title: Conversational draft iteration
requirements.description: Revision is genuinely conversational in a way that workflow actions are not — tighten this hook, cut the third point. Applied in place inside the open editor rather than as a separate chat surface, so the draft stays the object of attention. Conversational scoped revision is required in the accepted Marketing delivery while its earned status stays planned: explanatory answers never expose Apply; proposals compare exact selected base/span and create recoverable provenance-bearing revisions only after guarded adoption.

validation.notes: An instruction against an open draft produces a new revision with a visible diff and agent author kind.

requirements.title: Desktop packaging
requirements.description: Tier 2 desktop delivery through scenario-to-desktop is the external target, not hosted deployment (D-017). Local-first removes tenancy, a hosted credential surface, and sandboxed check execution by construction; a hosted product would reopen all three at once.

validation.notes: A desktop build starts, reaches the workbench, and reads local storage through the resolver.
